verdict.rationale: Plausible's only documented route to data residency is its first-party, self-hostable Community Edition, which lets you run it on infrastructure and in a location of your choosing. Community users confirm running it self-hosted, though one calls the setup heavy because it needs ClickHouse. Nothing shows a region or residency choice in the hosted cloud service, or where cloud data is stored. Missing for 10: region/residency selection for the managed cloud offering, documentation of hosted data location, explicit residency docs for self-hosting.
